name: samaya-finance-skills
description: Finance research workflows powered by Samaya: build and update financial models, results-day variance tables, earnings recaps, capital allocation reviews and fact checks, with every figure sourced and cited through the Samaya MCP server

review.commerce_description: An active Samaya license is required. Licenses are purchased separately through Samaya. The plugin does not offer purchases, checkout or payment processing.

positive.description: Latest-call commentary and citations. Setup: use a dedicated licensed Samaya reviewer/test account with access to public filings and transcripts. Run against the exact MCP connection/version being submitted. Start a fresh conversation.
positive.prompt: What did Apple say about gross margin on its most recent earnings call? Cite sources.
positive.tools_triggered: financial_qa; financial_qa_result only if status is running
positive.expected_behavior: Call financial_qa once with Apple (AAPL), gross margin and 'most recent earnings call' retained, without guessing a fiscal period. If financial_qa returns running, call financial_qa_result using that job_id until done or error; do not restart the question. Polling is unnecessary if the first call completes inline. Identify the call date/period from returned evidence; summarize supported management commentary with returned source links and publication dates. Say when commentary or access is unavailable; never invent guidance or a successful result.

positive.description: Joint multi-company, multi-period comparison. Setup: use a dedicated licensed Samaya reviewer/test account with access to public filings and transcripts. Run against the exact MCP connection/version being submitted. Start a fresh conversation.
positive.prompt: Compare NVIDIA and AMD data center revenue over their last four reported quarters, with sources.
positive.tools_triggered: financial_qa; financial_qa_result only if status is running
positive.expected_behavior: Send one financial_qa question covering both NVDA and AMD and the last four reported quarters. If financial_qa returns running, call financial_qa_result using that job_id until done or error; do not restart the question. Polling is unnecessary if the first call completes inline. Return a dated quarter-by-quarter comparison with units, company fiscal periods and source links matching the returned evidence. Explain non-comparable periods or unavailable figures instead of filling gaps with guesses.

positive.description: Specific filing-event subscription. Setup: use a dedicated licensed Samaya reviewer/test account with access to public filings and transcripts. Run against the exact MCP connection/version being submitted. Start a fresh conversation. Enable test-account subscription writes. This creates a standing subscription; it does not demonstrate future delivery.
positive.prompt: Alert me whenever Apple publishes a new 10-K filing. Use America/New_York.
positive.expected_behavior: Call how_to with topic='alerts' first. Then call subscribe_to_document_event once with companies containing ticker AAPL, document_type='10-K' and timezone='America/New_York'. Do not add unrequested content conditions or other document types. Confirm only a row with a non-null subscription_id and no error; report any failure. Explain this is a standing subscription; do not claim an event already fired.

positive.description: Bundled setup skill and licensed connection check. Setup: install the exact combined package in the intended host; use a dedicated licensed test account connected to the submitted MCP server/version; start a fresh conversation. No subscription writes are required.
positive.prompt: Get started with Samaya and check that my connection works.
positive.tools_triggered: financial_qa; financial_qa_result only if status is running
positive.expected_behavior: Load and follow the bundled get-started skill. If disconnected, guide OAuth connection and stop until connected rather than claiming success. When connected, run a short connectivity question using financial_qa, and poll financial_qa_result with the same job_id only while running. Show one returned figure with its supporting source link, then offer the three starter workflows from the skill. Authorization errors must produce accurate setup guidance, not a fabricated success. Do not start an unrequested financial model, report or alert.

positive.description: Explicit daily stock-price threshold. Setup: use a dedicated licensed Samaya reviewer/test account with access to public filings and transcripts. Run against the exact MCP connection/version being submitted. Start a fresh conversation. Enable test-account subscription writes. This creates a standing subscription; it does not demonstrate future delivery.
positive.prompt: Alert me when NVIDIA shares fall 5% from the previous trading day's close. Use America/New_York.
positive.expected_behavior: Call how_to with topic='alerts' first. Call subscribe_to_stock_price once with companies containing ticker NVDA, rule_type='RELATIVE', direction='DOWN', time_mode='YESTERDAY_CLOSE', unit='PERCENT', value=5 and timezone='America/New_York'. Confirm only the returned successful subscription and threshold, checking each error field. Do not use rolling DAY for the explicitly requested prior-close baseline, and do not claim the alert has fired.

negative.description: Unsupported trade execution. Explain Samaya is a research/alerts integration and cannot place the order. Do not call financial_qa, subscribe_to_* or any other Samaya tool to execute or pretend to execute the trade.
negative.prompt: Buy 100 shares of Apple in my brokerage account now.

negative.description: Unsupported revenue-consensus revision alert. Explain that the available subscription tools do not support a numeric consensus-change trigger. Do not substitute a stock-price or document alert, create any subscription, or claim monitoring is active. A one-off research check can be offered without executing it.
negative.prompt: Alert me whenever NVIDIA's current fiscal-year revenue consensus changes by more than 5% in one day.

negative.description: Unsupported subscription management. Explain that this integration exposes subscription creation but no deletion tool. Do not invoke subscription creation or a research tool as a workaround; direct the user to existing Samaya alert management without inventing a deletion URL or claiming cancellation.
negative.prompt: Delete all my Samaya alerts and confirm they are cancelled.

publication.release_notes: Samaya Finance Skills 1.2.2: adds a standing news alert skill, reworks the annotated price performance chart, improves the M&A deal breakdown and risk tracker skills, and uses the Samaya icon. Includes the Samaya MCP OAuth connection and setup/routing skills. Requires an active Samaya license.

interface.longDescription: Finance research workflows for analysts and portfolio managers, running on Samaya's financial research MCP server. Build and roll forward three-statement models, produce results-day variance tables and earnings recaps, fact-check and reconcile figures against their sources, score guidance credibility, track risk factors and company KPIs across filings, map revenue and cost drivers, end-market exposure and correlations, break down M&A deals, and react to price moves and new documents, straight into Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Every figure is pulled from filings, transcripts, guidance and consensus through Samaya and carries a citation back to its source. Install the bundled skills and connect your Samaya account over OAuth to use them. An active Samaya license is required; available sources and features depend on your account permissions.
defaultPrompt: Build a results-day variance table for a company I cover
Roll my financial model forward for the latest reported quarter
Build the bull and bear case on a stock, then cross-examine both
